title: crotalaria senegalensis var. carinata
intro: Crotalaria senegalensis var. carinata, commonly known as Horned rattlepod, is a plant species of the pea family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Crotalaria senegalensis var. carinata include its traditional use in treating fever and rheumatism due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can be used to treat various infections and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Crotalaria senegalensis var. carinata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
